mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.company_name as companyName FROM project p LEFT JOIN company c ON p.biz_no = c.biz_no ORDER BY p.prj_root_id, p.prj_lft
SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", login AS "login", email AS "email" FROM users WHERE biz_no = #{bizNo} AND name LIKE '%' || #{term} || '%' AND PRJ_MANAGER_CD = '01ACTIVE' AND status_cd = '01ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.prj_name, p.prj_identifier, p.prj_desc, p.created_on, p.start_date, p.closed_date, p.prj_hide, p.prj_status_cd, p.prj_par_id, p.prj_root_id, p.prj_lft, p.biz_no, g.id AS group_id, g.name AS group_name, m.id AS member_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name FROM project p INNER JOIN grp g ON p.id = g.prj_id INNER JOIN member m ON g.id = m.grp_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id AND p.biz_no = u.biz_no WHERE u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.start_date desc
mapper.insert: { CALL PROC_PROJECT_CREATE( #{prjName, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bizNo, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prjDesc, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prjParId, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prjIdentifier,mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enaId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, mode=IN, jdbcType=DATE}, #{closedDate, mode=IN, jdbcType=DATE}, #{copyPrjId, mode=IN, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{copyGroups, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{copyUsers, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{copyRoles, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultStatus, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultMsg, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) }
mapper.update: { CALL PROC_PROJECT_UPDATE( #{id}, #{prjName}, #{prjDesc}, #{userId}, #{prjParId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prjStatusCd}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{closedDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{enaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultStatus, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultMsg, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) }
mapper.select: SELECT e.ena_name_cd, get_sub_code_name(e.ena_name_cd) ena_name_nm, s.note AS module_code FROM enabled_modules e LEFT JOIN sub_code s ON e.ena_name_cd = s.s_code WHERE e.prj_id = #{prjId}
